task.description: WF-03 Step 2 (retroactive) -- produce design artefact for ISS-0808 fix already committed at 97c50b5d. Document interface decisions and regression guard rationale for SECURITY-REVIEWER/REVIEWER.

result.summary: Design artefact created. Key decisions documented: (1) The correction routes PLATFORM_ADMIN derivation through Authorization.roles_from_strings/1 — the single canonical string-to-atom converter — so all authorization consumers share one normalization path. (2) @platform_admin is an atom (:PLATFORM_ADMIN, not "PLATFORM_ADMIN"), which is the structural regression guard: an atom can never be a member of a [String.t()] list, so removing roles_from_strings/1 while keeping the atom constant always breaks the exemption and fails the ISS-0808 test suite. (3) The public Plug interface (init/1, call/2) is unchanged; only the internal roles derivation in check_tenant_status/2 changed. (4) No new public functions, no schema changes, no migrations. All three ISS-0808 acceptance criteria trace to concrete design elements.
